blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World models can imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, but growers need to know how a crop will develop over weeks to months: will this rice plant have headed a month from now, and how will it look at harvest? We introduce agricultural world modeling, the task of predicting how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months, from one photo of it, its cultivar, and its camera view. In preliminary analysis, even state-of-the-art image generators get this wrong: they often grow the plant too little or give it the color and form of the wrong growth stage. We argue that they do not work out the plant's developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. We therefore propose AgroWM, which reasons about development before it draws growth. Its reasoning module, PhenoClock, works out the current growth stage, predicts the future one, and writes a Growth Script with numeric targets for height, plant area, and color; its generation module, the Rooted Renderer, then edits the photo to follow this script, adding new organs and colors to the photographed plant. Because pixel scores can prefer an unchanged copy of the photo, we instead check each forecast's traits and developmental timing against the plant's own later photos. On rice, 54.6% of the forecasts of AgroWM are matched to the target stage (Stage R@1), against 34.8% for GPT Image 2.5, 24.0% for Qwen Image 2.1, and 47.4% for the strongest domain-specific baseline, the same backbone fine-tuned without Growth Scripts; 9 to 20 weeks ahead, it still reaches 46.4%, against 35.7% for that baseline. On maize, a crop with a different body plan and stage scale, the same design again scores best on all four measures.
blocks.zh: 世界模型可以想象一个物理场景在接下来的几秒钟里是如何演变的,但是种植者需要知道一种作物会如何在几周到几个月的时间里发展:这个稻田会从现在开始开花一个月,它如何看待收成? 我们引入了农业世界建模, 任务就是预测同一植物 将如何从它的一张照片,它的栽培物, 以及它的摄像头的角度, 来看待所要求天到月的地平线。 在初步分析中,即使是最先进的图像生成器也会得到这样的错误:它们常常生长的植物太少或者给它带来错生长阶段的颜色和形式. 我们提出,它们不能解决 植物的发育状态, 照片只间接揭示。 因此,我们建议农妇运动,在它取得增长之前,应该提出发展的理由。 其推理模块"PhenoClock"研究出了目前的生长阶段,预测了未来的阶段,并写了"生长脚本",其中包含高,植物面积,颜色的数值目标;其生成模块"根化伦代尔",然后编辑照片以遵循这个脚本,给被拍摄的植物添加了新的器官和颜色. 因为像素分数可以更喜欢照片的不变拷贝,我们转而对照工厂自己后来的照片来检查每个预测的特征和发展时间. 在大米方面,54.6%的AgroWM预测与目标阶段(Stage R@1)相匹配,而GPT图像为34.8%,Quen图像为24.0%,而最强域特定基线为47.4%,同一主干线经过微调后没有增长脚本;9至20周前,它仍然达到46.4%,而基准为35.7%。 在玉米上,一种有不同身体计划和舞台尺度的作物,同样的设计在所有四个尺度上都得分最高。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
World models [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] let machines imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, as when a glass falls, strikes a surface, and shatters ( Fig. 1 a).
Questions about growing food instead require forecasts over weeks to months: how tall will this plant grow, how much will its canopy spread, and when will it flower and fill its grain?
For rice, which feeds more than half of the world’s population [ 4 ] , the answers otherwise take up to a season to arrive.
We ask whether a world model can give them in advance: from one photo of a plant, its cultivar, and its camera view, predict how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months ( Fig. 1 b).
We call this task agricultural world modeling .
Its answer is a photo, which, unlike a single number, can be checked by eye and measured for any visible trait.
blocks.zh:
世界模型[1,2,3]让机器想象一个物理场景在接下来的几秒钟里是如何演化的,就像一个玻璃坠落,撞击一个表面,并震碎(图1a).
相反,关于种植粮食的问题需要数周到数月的预测:这种植物的生长会有多高,其树冠会扩大多少,何时开花并填满其谷物?
对于喂养世界半数以上人口的大米,答案可能要到一个季节。
我们问一个世界模型是否能够预先给出:从一个植物的一张照片、它的栽培物和它的相机视图中,可以预测同一个植物将如何看待所要求的天数到几个月(图1b)。
我们称之为农业世界建模的任务。
它的答案是一张照片,它与单个数字不同,可以用眼睛检查,并测量任何可见的特征.

blocks.en:
The task is harder than it looks, as shown by a preliminary study of 64 rice cases: 1–4 weeks (22 cases), 5–8 weeks (24), and 9–20 weeks (18) ( Sec. 3 ). First, two state-of-the-art image generators fail at it : Qwen Image 2.1 hardly changes the plant, although real plants grow about tenfold in projected area over 9 to 20 rounded weeks (median 11.2 × 11.2\times ), and GPT Image 2 grows it too little at long horizons, shows senescence-related color changes at the wrong stage, and redraws it toward a generic rice plant ( Fig. 2 ). Second, the horizon alone does not decide the future stage : of the 18 cases with horizons of 9 to 20 weeks, 6 plants have not yet headed by the target date, while 9 are already filling grain or ripening.
A forecaster must therefore infer each plant’s developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. Third, common image scores reward doing nothing : a copy of today’s photo has the highest SSIM in Tab. 1 , and Qwen Image 2.1, which barely changes the plant, the highest PSNR.
blocks.zh:
对64个大米病例的初步研究显示,这项任务比想象的要困难:1-4周(22例)、5-8周(24例)和9-20周(18例)(第3节)。 首先,两台最先进的图像发电机故障: Quen Image 2.1几乎不会改变工厂,虽然真实的植物在9至20个圆周的预测面积(中间值11.2×11.2\times)中增长约十倍,而GPT Image 2在长的地平线上生长得太少,在错误的阶段显示出与景色有关的颜色变化,并将其重新绘制为通用的米厂(图2)。 第二,光是地平线不能决定未来阶段:在18个地平线为9至20周的案例中,6个工厂还没有到预定日期,而9个工厂已经填满谷物或成熟。
因此,预测员必须推断每个植物的发育状态,照片只间接揭示了这种状态。 第三,常见图像评分: 今天照片的复制品在Tab. 1中是最高的SSIM, 而Quen Image 2.1则几乎改变不了植物,

Figure 1: From physical dynamics to growth. (a) A conventional world model predicts rapid physical events.
(b) From one photo, an agricultural world model predicts how the plant will look at each requested horizon of weeks to months, as it moves through growth stages.
blocks.zh:
图 1:从物理动态到增长. (a) 常规世界模型预测迅速的物理事件。
(b) 从一张照片看,一个农业世界模型预测,植物在进入生长阶段时,将如何看待每个要求的几周到几个月的视野。

blocks.en:
A reliable growth forecast must get the individual plant, its future traits, and their timing right.
Existing methods address only parts of this problem.
Time-lapse generators [ 5 , 6 ] draw plausible growth from text, with no particular plant or date to match, and keyframe interpolation [ 7 ] and 4D reconstruction [ 8 ] are given the later images that a forecast has to predict.
Plant-growth GANs [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] come closest, but they map elapsed time, treatment, or simulated biomass to pixels without reasoning about development.
Agricrafter [ 12 ] generates controllable videos of a crop’s full growth cycle, but a coherent sequence alone does not show whether a given plant reaches the correct stage within the requested horizon.
Crop models [ 13 , 14 ] do track development using temperature and day length, but require cultivar- and site-specific parameters and do not directly generate the future appearance of an individual plant.
Our approach follows an agronomist’s reasoning by first predicting the plant’s future developmental stage and then generating an image consistent with that prediction. For example, if a plant is currently tillering and is expected to reach jointing in four weeks, the forecast image should show elongated stems and a taller plant.
blocks.zh:
可靠的增长预测必须使单个植物、其未来特征和时机正确。
现有方法只涉及这个问题的部分内容。
时间跨度发生器[5,6]从文本中提取似似似增长,没有特定的厂房或日期相匹配,键框插值[7]和4D重建[8]得到预测必须预测的后期图像.
植物生长的GANs [9, 10, 11] 来得最近,但它们将经过的时间,处理,或模拟的生物量映射到像素上,而没有关于发展的推理.
Agricracter [12] 生成作物整个生长周期的可控视频,但仅靠一个连贯的序列并不能显示某一植物是否在所要求的视野内达到正确的阶段。
作物模型[13,14]使用温度和日长来进行跟踪开发,但需要种植物和场地特有的参数,不会直接产生单个植物的未来外观.
我们的方法遵循农学家的推理,首先预测植物的未来发展阶段,然后产生与这一预测一致的形象。 例如,如果一个植物目前正在耕作,预计四周内会达到关节,那么预报图像应显示长长的茎和高高的植物。

blocks.en:
We turn this insight into AgroWM, an agricultural world model with two modules ( Fig. 3 ).
First, its reasoning module, PhenoClock, is a vision-language model that works out the plant’s current stage, predicts its stage at the horizon, and writes this chain of thought (CoT) as a Growth Script.
The script is a short, structured note: the current and future stage and, for each visible trait such as height, plant area, and color, today’s value, the target value, and the change in words.
Since no dataset records such notes, PhenoClock learns from scripts written in hindsight: for each training pair, the stages and values come from records and measurements of the real future, and a language model adds the words ( Sec. 4.2 ).
Second, its generation module, the Rooted Renderer, then edits today’s photo as the script says; it is prompted and trained to keep the plant’s form, framing, and scale, on pairs chosen to reward real growth ( Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们把这个洞察力转化为AgroWM,这是一个农业世界模型,有两个模块(图3)。
首先,它的推理模块PhenoClock是一个视觉语言模型,它能研究出植物的目前阶段,在地平线上预测它的阶段,并将这个思想链(CoT)写成一个增长脚本.
剧本是一个简短的,结构化的注解:当前和未来的舞台,对于高度,植物面积,颜色等每个可见的特征,今天的值,目标值,以及文字的变化.
由于没有数据集记录这种笔记,PhenoClock从事后写成的脚本中学习:对于每一个训练对子,阶段和值来自真实未来的记录和测量,一个语言模型会添加词(sec.4.2.).
第二,它的生成模块,即根化器,然后按剧本所言编辑今天的照片;它受到激励和训练,使工厂的形式、框架和规模保持在选择的对子上,以奖励真正的增长(第4.3节)。

blocks.en:
To judge forecasts, we check what matters to a grower: the same plant, at the right size and color, at the right stage of development ( Sec. 3.2 ).
Timing is checked against the plant’s own photo series: Stage R@1 is the share of forecasts whose most similar photo of the plant lies in the target stage.
On held-out plants of the public rice dataset WGSR [ 15 ] , AgroWM reaches 54.6% Stage R@1, against 34.8% for GPT Image 2.5 and 24.0% for Qwen Image 2.1, two state-of-the-art generators, and 47.4% for the strongest domain-specific model, the same backbone fine-tuned on the same pairs without Growth Scripts ( Tab. 1 ).
Reasoning about development thus adds 7.2 points (95% CI 5.2–9.2), and 10.7 points 9 to 20 weeks ahead ( Fig. 4 ).
On maize, which grows a single stalk with a tassel instead of tillers and panicles, the same design again scores best, so the approach is not tied to one crop ( Sec. 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
为了判断预测,我们检查对种植者重要的是什么:同一株植物,体积和颜色适当,处于发展的适当阶段(第3.2节)。
时间与工厂自己的照片系列相匹配: R@1阶段是其最相似的工厂照片位于目标阶段的预测比例.
在公共水稻数据集WGSR[15]的停产工厂上,AgroWM达到了54.6%的阶段R@1,而GPT图像为34.8%,Quen图像2.1为24.0%,两台最先进的发电机,而最强的域特有模型为47.4%,同一骨干在相同的对上进行了微调,没有增长脚本(附件1)。
因此,关于发展的理由增加了7.2分(95%CI 5.2–9.2),提前9-20周增加了10.7分(图4)。
在玉米上,这种玉米用泰瑟枪而不是耕机和惊慌剂来生长单一的树茎,同样的设计再次得分最好,因此方法没有与一种作物挂钩(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: In summary, we make three contributions: • We explore agricultural world modeling and find that the current image generators do not pace a plant’s growth to the horizon, reach its target stage, or keep the individual. • We propose AgroWM, which reasons before it renders: PhenoClock forecasts the developmental stage with the plant’s height, area, and color as an agricultural CoT learned from scripts written in hindsight, and the Rooted Renderer turns this forecast into an edited photo of the plant; it gives the best forecasts on both rice and maize. • We show that standard metrics such as PSNR and SSIM are useless in guiding the generation of ecologically meaningful plants, and introduce an evaluation of identity, geometry, color, and timing against the plant’s growth series.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们作出了三项贡献: 我们探索农业世界的模型设计,发现目前的图像生成器没有使植物的生长速度达到地平线,没有达到目标阶段,也没有保持个体。 我们提议AgroWM,它提出的理由是:PhenoClock用植物的高度、面积和颜色来预测开发阶段,这是从事后记录的脚本中学习出来的农业CoT,而Rooted Renderer将这一预测变成一个经过编辑的植物照片;它提供了水稻和玉米的最佳预测。 我们显示,PSNR和SSIM等标准衡量标准在引导产生具有生态意义的植物以及针对植物生长系列引入身份、几何、颜色和时间的评价方面是无用的。

blocks.en: We explore agricultural world modeling and find that the current image generators do not pace a plant’s growth to the horizon, reach its target stage, or keep the individual.
blocks.zh: 我们探索农业世界的建模,发现目前的图像生成器不会加速植物的生长到地平线,到达目标阶段,或者保持个体。

blocks.en: We propose AgroWM, which reasons before it renders: PhenoClock forecasts the developmental stage with the plant’s height, area, and color as an agricultural CoT learned from scripts written in hindsight, and the Rooted Renderer turns this forecast into an edited photo of the plant; it gives the best forecasts on both rice and maize.
blocks.zh: 我们提出AgroWM, 之前的理由有: PhenoClock以植物的高度、面积和颜色来预测开发阶段, 这是一种从事后记录的脚本中汲取的农业CoT, 根发者将这一预测转换成经过编辑的植物照片; 它提供了水稻和玉米的最佳预测。

blocks.en: We show that standard metrics such as PSNR and SSIM are useless in guiding the generation of ecologically meaningful plants, and introduce an evaluation of identity, geometry, color, and timing against the plant’s growth series.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,PSNR和SSIM等标准衡量标准在引导产生具有生态意义的植物以及针对植物生长系列引入身份、几何、颜色和时间的评价方面是无用的。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 World Models in Computer Vision
blocks.zh: 2.1 计算机远景的世界模式

blocks.en:
World models learn how an environment evolves, first as latent simulators for control [ 16 , 17 ] and now as large video generators presented as world simulators [ 1 , 18 , 19 ] for games [ 20 , 21 ] , driving [ 2 ] , and robots [ 3 , 22 ] .
Longer horizons have been reached by temporal abstraction, which predicts directly at coarse or adaptive steps [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] , and learned weather models forecast physical fields days ahead [ 28 , 29 ] .
These models primarily predict physical dynamics, including object motion, interactions, and the evolution of physical fields. We open a regime they do not cover : the growth of an organism over days to months, driven by a state that the image shows only indirectly.
blocks.zh:
世界模型学习环境如何演化,首先作为控制的潜在模拟器[16,17],现在作为世界模拟器展示的大型视频发电机[1,18,19],用于游戏[20,21],驱动[2],机器人[3,22].
时间抽象已经达到了更长的地平线,它直接在粗糙或适应的步骤[23, 24, 25, 26, 27] 上演的天气模型预测了未来的物理场日[28, 29].
这些模型主要预测物理动态,包括物体运动,相互作用,以及物理领域的演变. 我们打开了一个它们没有覆盖的制度:一个生物体在几天到几个月的时间里生长,其动力是图像只间接显示的状态。

blocks.en:
Video generators often violate physical laws despite realistic frames [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] and lack a consistent time scale [ 33 ] .
Time-lapse generation [ 34 , 35 , 5 , 6 ] targets slow processes from text, with no individual’s real future as ground truth, keyframe interpolation [ 7 ] is given the last frame, and face aging [ 36 ] involves no new organs.
These tasks often use pixel and perceptual metrics [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] to measure visual similarity, but such metrics can favor blurry averages under uncertainty [ 40 , 41 ] . In addition, FID [ 42 ] compares image distributions and reflects both visual fidelity and diversity, but does not separate their contributions to the score.
We extend this probing from physical consistency to the timing of biological development. Genotype, environment, and management shape a plant’s developmental trajectory, so elapsed time alone does not determine its future stage. A forecaster must infer where the plant is in its development and how far it will progress over the requested horizon. A realistic image can still be the wrong forecast: its size, color, or organs may be plausible but mistimed. We therefore score timing by retrieval in the same plant’s photo series (Sec. 3.2).
blocks.zh:
尽管有现实的框架[30、31、32],但录像发电机经常违反实体法,而且缺乏一致的时间尺度[33]。
时间跨度的生成[34、35、5、6]从文本中瞄准缓慢的过程,没有个人作为地面真相的真正未来,关键框架插值[7]被赋予最后一个框架,面对老化[36]不涉及新的器官。
这些任务经常使用像素和感官度量[37,38,39]来测量视觉相似性,但这种度量可以倾向于不确定性下的模糊平均值[40,41]. 此外,FID[42]比较了图像的分布,既反映了视觉的忠诚性,也反映了多样性,但没有将其对分数的贡献分开.
我们把这种探险从物理一致性扩大到生物发展的时机。 基因类型、环境和管理决定了植物的发展轨迹,因此仅靠时间不能决定其未来阶段。 预测员必须推断该工厂的开发情况以及它将在所要求范围内取得多大进展。 现实的图像仍然可能是错误的预测:其大小、颜色或器官可能令人信服,但时机错误。 因此,我们在同一工厂的照片系列(第3.2节)中通过检索获得时间。

blocks.en:
Multimodal language models have been used to plan image edits [ 43 , 44 ] and to reason before synthesis [ 45 ] , extending chain-of-thought prompting [ 46 ] , and CausalWM [ 47 ] reasons about causal variables before predicting video.
Their reasoning concerns layout, semantics, or short-term physics. PhenoClock differs in what it reasons about and where its supervision comes from : it advances a hidden developmental state by a requested horizon and states it in image measurements, in a schema designed with agronomic knowledge.
Its training scripts are written backwards from real future images around recorded stages and measured values, in the spirit of privileged information [ 48 , 49 ] and rationalization [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh:
多种语言模型被用于规划图像编辑[43,44],并在合成[45]前进行推理,延伸思维链提示[46],以及CausalWM[47]在预测视频之前对因果变量的原因.
他们的推理涉及布局,语义,或短期物理学. PhenoClock在它的原因和监管来源上有所不同:它通过要求的视野推进了隐藏的发育状态,并在图像测量中,用农学知识设计出来的计划来表述.
本着特权信息[48、49]和合理化[50]的精神,其培训脚本从记录阶段和计量价值的实际未来图像向后写出。

blocks.en: 2.2 Modeling Growth in Agriculture
blocks.zh: 2.2 农业增长模式

blocks.en:
Agronomists have long forecast crops with process-based models: crop models such as ORYZA2000 [ 13 ] , DSSAT [ 14 ] , APSIM [ 51 ] , and WOFOST [ 52 ] advance a developmental state with temperature and day length and simulate biomass and yield from weather, soil, and structural plant models simulate architecture [ 53 , 54 ] .
They need cultivar- and site-specific parameters and output numbers or geometry rather than the appearance of a particular plant. We keep their central idea, a developmental state advanced through time, but infer it from the photo and render it as an image .
blocks.zh:
农学家具有长期预测作物的工序模型:如ORYZA2000[13]、DSSAT[14]、APSIM[51]和WOFOST[52]等作物模型,推进了温度和日长的开发状态,并模拟了来自天气、土壤和结构植物模型的生物量和产量模拟建筑[53、54]。
它们需要种植物和地点特有的参数和输出数或几何,而不是特定植物的外观. 我们保持他们的中心思想, 一个发展状态在时间中前进, 但从照片中推断出来,

blocks.en:
Image-based phenotyping describes the plant’s current state: vision models segment organs, measure traits, and estimate plant age from photographs [ 55 , 56 , 57 ] .
Growth forecasting goes further by predicting its later appearance.
Plant-growth GANs predict future images from earlier photos, using fixed prediction intervals or explicit time, treatment, and biomass conditions, and assess their outputs through image quality and trait agreement [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] .
Agricrafter [ 12 ] generates full-growth-cycle crop videos with diffusion models, and 4D reconstruction [ 8 ] recovers growth that has already been imaged.
We explicitly forecast the future developmental state of the plant to guide image generation from a current photo at horizons of up to 20 weeks, and evaluate the developmental timing of the plant’s photo series, on two crops.
blocks.zh:
基于图像的麻黄(phinotyping)描述了植物的目前状态:视觉模型分块器官,测量特征,以及从照片中估计植物年龄[55,56,57].
增长预测通过预测其后来的出现更进一步。

blocks.en: 3.1 How Existing Models Fail
blocks.zh: 3.1 现有模式如何失败

blocks.en:
The further ahead a forecast looks, the more the plant should change, but neither generator keeps pace with the real change.
Qwen Image 2.1 barely changes the plant: its median projected area
is 0.93 × 0.93\times to 0.98 × 0.98\times today’s, while real plants grow 2.7 × 2.7\times , 4.4 × 4.4\times , and 11.2 × 11.2\times in the three ranges.
GPT Image 2 grows the plant with the horizon but falls further behind,
reaching 2.4 × 2.4\times , 3.0 × 3.0\times , and 5.6 × 5.6\times ( Fig. 2 a).
blocks.zh:
展望未来 工厂应该改变的越多 但发电机都跟不上真正的变化
Qwen 图像 2.1 勉强改变厂房:它的中位预测面积
0.93 × 0.93\时为今天的0.98× 0.98\时,而真正的植物生长2.7× 2.7\时,4.4× 4.4\时,11.2× 11.2\时为三个范围。
常规 图像2以地平线生长植物 但更落后
达到2.4×2.4\时间,3.0×3.0\时间,5.6×5.6\时间(图2a).

blocks.en:
How a plant looks depends on its growth stage, and the generators often draw the wrong one.
Although the prompt forbids it, GPT Image 2 yellows young plants early: in 8 of the 15 front-view cases that stay vegetative, the share of yellow or brown plant pixels in its forecast exceeds the real plant’s by more than 10 percentage points ( Fig. 2 b).
Both models keep ripening plants green: in the 22 cases at grain filling or ripening, the real plants are 54% yellow or brown on average, against 24% for GPT Image 2 and 23% for Qwen Image 2.1 (② in Fig. 2 ).
The horizon alone cannot fix the stage: at 9–20 rounded weeks, 6 of the 18 plants have not yet headed, while 9 are filling grain or ripening, so each plant follows its own clock.
blocks.zh:
植物的外观取决于其生长阶段,发电机往往画错了.
虽然提示禁止,GPT 图片2 黄种幼株早期:在15个保持植物状的前视病例中,8个病例中,黄种或棕种植物像素在预测中的份额超过真种植物的10多个百分点(图2b).
两种模式都使成熟的植物保持绿色:在22种谷物填充或成熟的情况下,真正的植物平均为54%的黄色或棕色,而GPT图像2为24%,Quen图像2.1为23%(2图2)。
光是地平线无法固定舞台:在9~20圆周,18个植物中有6个尚未开工,而9个正在填充谷物或成熟,所以每个植物都遵循自己的时钟.

blocks.en:
A forecast must show the same individual plant, but GPT Image 2 often changes its form toward a typical rice plant.
In front views it draws a taller, upright plant, more than 10 points of image height too tall in 13 of the 32 cases ( Fig. S1 e); in top views it draws a symmetric rosette ( Fig. 2 a, c).
Qwen Image 2.1 keeps the individual mostly by not changing it.
blocks.zh:
预测必须显示同样的单个植物,但GPT Image 2经常改变其形态,变成典型的稻种.
在前面的视图中,它画了一个更高,直立的植株,32个病例中有13个超过10点的图像高度太高(图S1 e);在顶部视图中它画了一个对称的玫瑰花(图2 a,c).
Quen Image 2.1主要通过不改变来保留个人.

blocks.en:
Together, these failures suggest that the generators jump from today’s photo and the horizon straight to a new photo, without working out the plant’s developmental state, and fall back on a generic picture of rice.
Our method is therefore built around three requirements: (T1) advance the developmental state explicitly (①); (T2) read the plant’s own stage first and derive its traits from it (②); and (T3) keep the individual and change only what development changes (③).
blocks.zh:
这些失败合在一起表明,发电机从今天的照片和地平线直跳到新的照片上,而没有研究出工厂的发展状态,而是回到了普通的稻米照片上。
因此,我们的方法围绕三项要求而建立:(T1) 明确推进开发状态(1);(T2) 读取工厂自己的阶段,并从中得出其特点(2);和(T3) 保持个体,只改变开发变化(3)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Our Evaluation Design
blocks.zh: 3.2 我们的评价设计

blocks.en: Assessing whether forecasts meet these requirements calls for more than visual similarity. We first examine where standard scores fall short, then define an evaluation of identity, size, color, and developmental timing.
blocks.zh: 评估预测是否符合这些要求,需要的不仅仅是视觉上的相似性。 我们首先审查标准分数不足的地方,然后界定对身份、大小、颜色和发展时间的评价。

blocks.en:
Standard scores do not catch these failures: pixel scores favor an unchanged photo, and the other scores each see only part of the change.
In the 64 cases, plants cover only 14% of the real future photo, so PSNR and SSIM mostly measure the white background, and an unchanged copy of today’s photo gets the highest mean PSNR and SSIM of all forecasts we score (14.9 dB and 0.81, against 14.2 dB and 0.75 for GPT Image 2).
DINOv2 similarity [ 39 ] depends less on the background,
but its scale shifts with the horizon: the copy scores 0.74 at 1–4
rounded weeks and 0.41 at 9–20, so a value means little without its horizon.
Single traits see growth but not development: GPT Image 2 beats the copy and Qwen Image 2.1 in projected area in 52 of the 64 cases, yet in 33 of them the forecast looks most like a photo from another stage ( Fig. 2 b).
blocks.zh:
标准分数不捕捉到这些失败:像素分数倾向于不变照片,其他分数各只看到部分变化.
在64个案例中,植物只覆盖了真实未来照片的14%,因此PSNR和SSIM大多测量白色背景,一个不变的现今照片拷贝获得了所有我们得分的预测中最高的平均值PSNR和SSIM(14.9 dB和0.81),而GPT图像2则是14.2 dB和0.75.
DINov2相似性[39] 较少取决于背景,
但其尺度随地平线变化:副本在1比4得分0.74
圆周数和0.41在9–20,所以一个值没有它的地平线意义很小.
单一特征是增长而不是发展: 常规 在64个案例中,52个案例的预测面积中,图像2胜过副本,Quen图像2.1,而其中33个案例的预测看起来最像另一个阶段的照片(图2b)。

blocks.en:
We score four parts of a forecast separately. (i) Identity (③): DINOv2 feature similarity (DINO) and foreground-mask IoU with the real future. (ii) Size and shape (①, ③): errors, in points of the image, of projected area, plant height, and density, the plant’s share of its convex hull. (iii) Color (②): error of the yellow–brown share of plant pixels. (iv) Timing (①, ②): we rank the photos of the same plant and view, today’s included (14 on average), by DINOv2 ViT-B/14 similarity to the forecast; Stage R@1 and Event R@1 are the shares of forecasts whose top photo lies in the target stage or is the real target.
Since these photos share the plant and camera, a forecast that does not grow matches today’s photo: Qwen Image 2.1 reaches an Event R@1 of only 1.1%, worse than picking a photo at random (at least 7%; Tab. 1 ).
On the 2,000 validation queries, PSNR and SSIM prefer this no-growth forecast to AgroWM on 51% and 93%, the timing scores on 6% and 1% ( Tab. S1 ; ④ in Fig. 2 ), so PSNR and SSIM are for reference only.
A Growth Script states the target size and color, so these errors may favor AgroWM; the timing scores use only the forecast image and recorded labels.
blocks.zh:
我们的预测分为四部分 (一)身份(3):DINOv2特征相似性(DINO)和前景-任务IoU与真实未来. (二)大小与形状(1,3):图像点中误差,投影面积,植物高度,密度,植物占对流体的比例. (三)彩色(2):植物像素中黄褐色比例的误差. (四)时机(1,2):我们今天将同一厂房和景点的照片排在首位,包括今天的平均照片(14张),由DINov2 VIT-B/14与预测相似;阶段R@1和事件R@1是预测的股份,其顶级照片位于目标阶段或是真正的目标。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
AgroWM answers two questions in turn, what the plant will become and how it will then look ( Fig. 3 ), instead of asking one generator to guess the developmental state, the amount of growth, and what to keep all at once ( Sec. 3 ).
The reasoning module, PhenoClock ( Sec. 4.2 ), answers the first: from today’s photo and the query, it predicts a measured Growth Script (T1, T2).
The generation module, the Rooted Renderer ( Sec. 4.3 ), answers the second: it edits the same photo as the script says (T3).
In training, a Hindsight Tutor that sees both photos of a pair writes the words of its reference script around recorded stages and measured values.

AgroWM依次回答两个问题:植物会变成什么,然后它会是什么样子(图3),而不是要求一个生成者来猜测发育状态,生长量,以及什么可以同时保持所有(第3节).
推理模块PhenoClock(第4.2节)回答了第一个问题:从今天的照片和查询中,它预测了一个量度增长脚本(T1,T2).
生成模块Rooted Renderer (Sec. 4.3 )回答了第二个问题:它编辑了与剧本(T3)相同的照片.
在训练中,一个看到双人两张照片的Hindsight导师在录制的阶段和测量值周围写下其参考脚本的文字.

blocks.en: 4.2 Reasoning Module: PhenoClock
blocks.zh: 4.2 理由 模块: 时钟

blocks.en:
PhenoClock answers the first question, what the plant will become.
It is a vision-language model whose output, a structured chain of thought, spells out how the plant will develop.
Unlike free-form reasoning before generation [ 45 ] , this chain of thought must be exact enough to draw and to check, and WGSR does not provide it.
We therefore define what it contains, write training examples in hindsight, and teach PhenoClock to produce them from today’s photo.

与世代前的自由形式推理[45]不同,这种思维链必须精确到可以绘制和检查,而WGSR并不提供.
因此,我们界定其中包含的内容,在后视中写出训练范例,并教PhenoClock从今天的照片中制作这些实例。

The future reaches PhenoClock only through this label, as in learning with privileged information [ 48 , 49 ] , and the label’s source-side stage and values also teach PhenoClock to read today’s plant.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generation Module: Rooted Renderer
blocks.zh: 4.3 生成模块:根式渲染器

blocks.en:
The Rooted Renderer answers the second question, how the plant will then look: it should add the organs and colors that the Growth Script states and keep the rest of today’s photo, whereas the generators of Sec. 3 either leave the plant unchanged (①) or alter it (③).
We build it from a pretrained image generation and editing model with three choices, one per paragraph below: it edits today’s photo, it learns from pairs that reward real growth, and it trains on the Hindsight Tutor’s scripts.
blocks.zh:
根化器回答了第二个问题,即工厂的外观会怎样:它应该增加生长文稿所描述的器官和颜色,并保留今天的其余照片,而Sec 3的产生者要么让工厂保持不变(1),要么改变(3)。
我们用一个经过预先训练的图像生成和编辑模型来构建它,它有三个选择,一个是下面的段落:它编辑今天的照片,从奖励真正成长的对子中学习,它用Hindsight教学的脚本来训练.

blocks.en:
The Rooted Renderer edits today’s photo instead of drawing a new one: the source photo is the edit image in training and at test time, and every target keeps the frame of its source, in which the numbers of the Growth Script are defined.
The prompt states the task (accession, view, and horizon in whole weeks), a fixed keep-list (same identity, background, framing, and scale; development only forward, without premature yellowing or panicles), and the Growth Script.
A prompt alone is not enough, since GPT Image 2 received the same keep-list and still altered the plant ( Sec. 3 ); the Rooted Renderer instead learns to follow it from its training pairs.
blocks.zh:
Rooted Render编辑了今天的照片,而不是绘制新的照片:源照片是训练时和测试时的编辑图像,每个目标都保留其源的框架,其中定义了增长脚本的数字.
该提示说明了任务(加入、视图和整个星期的视野)、固定的保存列表(相同的身份、背景、框架和规模;只向前发展,不过早黄化或惊慌)和增长脚本。
单靠迅速是不够的,因为GPT 图像2收到同样的保留列表,仍然更改了厂房(sec. 3);而根化伦德尔则从它的训练配对中学习跟随它.

blocks.en:
A generator learns whatever its training pairs reward.
Among the candidate pairs, however, long horizons are scarce, short ones are nearly solved by copying, and early stages appear mostly as sources and late ones as targets.
We therefore fix a target share for each horizon range and, within each split, select candidate pairs within weekly quotas by a mixed-integer program that makes each stage appear about as often as a source as a target, with at least one pair per plant ( Eq. 7 in Appendix D ).
From the candidates, we drop pairs whose change is not growth, such as backward stages or early yellowing, and draw the final pairs stratified by source and target stage; the fine-tuned baselines use them too.
blocks.zh:
发电机会学习它训练的奖励
然而,在候选配对中,长的视野很少,短的几近通过抄袭解决,早期多作为来源出现,晚期则作为目标出现.
因此,我们确定每个地平线范围的目标份额,并在每个拆分中,由一个混合整数程序在每周配额内选择候选对数,使每个阶段作为目标经常出现,每个工厂至少有一对(附录D第7点)。
从考生中,我们放下变化不是生长的对子,如落后的阶段或早期的黄化,并画出最终对子的分层,按源头和目标阶段;微调的基线也使用它们.

blocks.en:
The Rooted Renderer should learn that following the script pays off, so we train it with the Hindsight Tutor’s scripts s ⋆ s^{\star} , whose stages and values match the target, and give it the scripts s ^ \hat{s} of PhenoClock only at test time; imperfect predicted scripts in training could teach it to ignore the script.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We validate AgroWM on two crops that grow very differently, with two public datasets of the Open Plant Image Archive (OPIA) [ 61 ] .
WGSR [ 15 ] photographs 93 rice cultivars about once a week over the season; we keep its top view and one side (front) view with white backgrounds, labeled with the eight growth stages of Sec. 4.2 and each cultivar’s heading date.
WGSM [ 62 ] photographs 224 maize inbred lines across nine growth stages, from vegetative growth to physiological maturity, and we keep one side view.
Each query pairs an earlier and a later photo of the same plant and view; rice pairs are 4 to 140 days apart (median 35).
We split by plant: rice has 20,000 training queries from 252 plants and 2,000 validation queries from 79 held-out plants, 78 of whose cultivars also occur in training, and maize has 6,400 and 1,600 queries from 348 and 84 plants ( Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
AgroWM outperforms all seven state-of-the-art generators on every identity, geometry, color, and timing score ( Tab. 1 ), with Stage and Event R@1 of 54.6% and 24.8%, against 34.8% and 10.8% for GPT Image 2.5 and 24.0% and 1.1% for Qwen Image 2.1.
These generators change the plant too little or without control: Qwen Image 2.1 barely changes it, the other open models miss its area by 14 to 42 points, two to six times the error of the copy, and GPT Image 2, the best of them in Stage R@1, reaches 35.3%.
Fine-tuning on our pairs helps all three generators we fine-tune, raising Stage R@1 from 24.5% to 46.9% for LANCE, from 25.2% to 39.3% for FLUX.2 Klein, and from 24.0% to 47.4% for Qwen Image 2.1, all above the 32.1% of Agricrafter.
Adding Growth Scripts on top of the same backbone and pairs lifts AgroWM above every domain-specific model, by at least 7.2 and 2.3 points in Stage and Event R@1.
It also has the best identity and trait scores of all generated forecasts, except IoU, where LANCE FT and Agricrafter are slightly higher (0.342 and 0.329 against 0.327).

这些发电机对工厂的改变太少或失控: Quen Image 2.1几乎没有改变它,其他的开放型号错失了它的面积14到42分,是副本错误的2到6倍,而GPT Image 2在阶段R@1中最好达到35.3%.
精细调整我们的配对可以帮助我们微调所有三台发电机,将R@1阶段从24.5%提高到46.9%,将FLUX.2 Klein阶段从25.2%提高到39.3%,将Quen图像2.1阶段从24.0%提高到47.4%,均高于Agricraver阶段的32.1%。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We asked whether world models can forecast the slow change of living things, and found that two state-of-the-art image generators either barely change a rice plant or change it at the wrong pace and stage, while pixel scores favor the unchanged plant.
AgroWM narrows this gap by reasoning before rendering: it first forecasts a Growth Script of the plant’s development, learned from scripts written in hindsight, and then edits the photo to match.
Reasoning adds 7.2 points of Stage R@1 over the same backbone without Growth Scripts, most beyond four weeks, and puts AgroWM ahead of state-of-the-art generators and domain-specific models on both rice and maize, two crops with different body plans and stage scales.
Because each forecast is a photo of the same plant, we can check its identity, size, color, and developmental timing against the plant’s own later photos.
The rice results come from potted plants on one greenhouse platform, with the background removed, mostly of cultivars seen in training, and from pairs filtered for growth.
Future work will condition forecasts on weather and management records and test them on new cultivars, more species, and field images.
blocks.zh:
我们问世界模型是否能够预测生命物的缓慢变化,发现两个最先进的图像生成器要么勉强改变一个米厂,要么在错误的速度和阶段改变它,而像素得分则倾向于不变的厂家.
AgroWM在渲染前通过推理缩小了这一差距:它首先预测了植物发育的生长脚本,从后视所写的脚本中学习,然后编辑照片以匹配.
理性在没有增长脚本的同一骨干上增加了7.2分的阶段R@1,大部分时间超过4周,并使AgroWM在水稻和玉米这两个具有不同身体计划和阶段规模的作物上都领先于最先进的发电机和田域特有模型.
因为每个预测都是同一个植物的照片, 我们可以对照植物本身的后期照片来检查它的身份、大小、颜色和发展时间。
水稻的结果来自一个温室平台上的盆栽植物,其背景被移除,大多是训练中看到的栽培植物,以及过滤成对生长.
今后的工作将限制对天气和管理记录的预测,并对新的栽培物、更多的物种和实地图像进行测试。

GPT Image 2 paces its edits only loosely by the interval: after three weeks, it adds panicles to a plant that is still jointing ( Fig. S1 a), whereas after eleven weeks, it keeps a young tillering plant at 6 × 6\times its area, against 65 × 65\times for the real plant ( Fig. S1 b).
In front views, it turns a plant that is still jointing 72% yellow or brown, against 22% in reality ( Fig. S1 c), and draws a plant taller, reaching 87% of the image height where the real plant stays at 58% ( Fig. S1 e).
Ripening plants stay green in both models ( Fig. S1 d), most of all in top views, where the real plants are on average 63% yellow or brown, against 9% for GPT Image 2.

blocks.en:
This section expands Sec. 3.2 .
We compare two forecasts with little or no growth, the exact copy of today’s photo and Qwen Image 2.1, which barely changes it, with that of AgroWM, which sees only today’s photo, the horizon, and the conditions: Tab. S1 counts how often each score prefers no growth over the 2,000 validation queries, and the 64 cases below show why.
All scores are computed by one evaluator on the white-background images.
blocks.zh:
本节扩充第3.2节.
我们比较了两种预测, 即今日照片和Quen影像2.1的准确副本, 几乎没有改变, Tab. S1计算每个分数比2,000个验证查询更倾向于不增长,以下64个案例说明了原因.
所有分数均由一名评价员在白底图像上计算。

blocks.en: Table S1: Which scores reward no growth? Left: share of the validation queries on which a score strictly prefers the copy or Qwen Image 2.1 to AgroWM; ties count in the denominator but not as wins. Right: validation means (errors in percentage points, R@1 in %). Height on 1,000 front views, DINO and R@1 on 1,964 queries, the rest on 2,000.
blocks.zh: 表S1:哪些分数奖励不增长? 左键:一个分数严格偏爱副本或Quen Image 2.1到 AgroWM 的验证查询的共享;带子在分母中计数,但不作为胜负. Right: 校验表示( 百分点的误差, R@ 1 in%) 。 1000个前卫的高度,DINO和R@1的1,964个查询,其余2000个查询.

blocks.en:
Over the 64 cases, the copy has a mean PSNR of 14.9 dB and a mean SSIM of 0.81, against 14.7 dB and 0.78 for Qwen Image 2.1 and 14.2 dB and 0.75 for GPT Image 2.
Plants cover on average 14% of a real future photo in the 64 cases, and 17% over the validation set; the rest is white background.
PSNR and SSIM therefore weigh mostly pixels that a forecast leaves untouched when it does not grow, and they penalize a leaf drawn slightly off twice, where it is and where it should be, but a missing leaf only once.
SSIM prefers the copy to AgroWM in 63 of the 64 cases, and PSNR in 38.
In Fig. S2 a, the only forecast with the right size and stage receives the lowest PSNR and SSIM of the three, 1.3 dB below Qwen Image 2.1.
Over the 2,000 validation queries, Qwen Image 2.1, which barely changes the plant, has the highest PSNR of all deployable models in Tab. 1 , only the copy has a higher SSIM, and both are above AgroWM.
blocks.zh:
在64起案件中,该副本的平均PSNR为14.9 dB,平均SSIM为0.81,而Quen图像2.1和14.2 dB为0.78,GPT图像2为0.75。
工厂平均覆盖64例真实未来照片的14%,超过验证组的17%;其余为白色背景.
因此,PSNR和SSIM的重量大多是预测值在不生长时会留下未变的像素,它们会惩罚略微脱落两次的叶子,在哪里和应该在哪里,但缺失的叶子只有一次.
SSIM更喜欢在64例中63例的抄袭给AgroWM,38例为PSNR.
以法义. S2 a,唯一一个具有适当大小和舞台的预测得到的PSNR和SSIM在3个中最低,1.3 dB低于Quen Image 2.1.
超过2000个验证查询,Qwen Image 2.1几乎改变不了厂房,在Tab的所有可部署模型中拥有最高的PSNR. 1,只有副本有更高的SSIM,两者都高于AgroWM.

blocks.en:
Cosine similarity of DINOv2 features [ 39 ] between the forecast and the real future depends little on the background and prefers the copy to AgroWM in only 8 of 63 cases.
Its value, however, depends on the horizon as much as on the forecast: the copy scores 0.74 at 1–4 weeks and 0.41 at 9–20 weeks, so the same value can mean a good long-horizon forecast or no change at a short horizon.
Over the validation set, the copy reaches 0.702, higher than five of the seven general-purpose generators and below only GPT Image 2 and GPT Image 2.5 (0.709 and 0.721).
A single similarity also cannot say in which direction a forecast is wrong, whether too early, too late, or not the same plant.
blocks.zh:
DINOv2特征在预测与真实未来之间的余弦相似性[39]几乎不取决于背景,在63个案例中只有8个案例更喜欢抄袭到AgroWM.
然而,其价值与预测一样取决于地平线:副本在1–4周时得分0.74分,在9–20周时得分0.41分,因此,同样的价值可以意味着良好的长视距预测或者在短视时没有变化.
在验证组上,复制件达到0.702,高于7台通用发电机中的5台,仅低于GPT图像2和GPT图像2.5(0.709和0.721).
单一的相似性也不能说一个预测是错的,无论是太早,太晚,还是同一个植物.

blocks.en:
Measured on the plant pixels alone, the errors in visible area, vertical extent, and yellow–brown share see the growth that pixel scores miss: in Fig. S2 a Qwen Image 2.1 is 20.4 and 40.2 points off in area and extent, against 0.5 and 0.0 for AgroWM.
Each trait, however, sees only one side of development.
A forecast of the right size can be at the wrong stage: GPT Image 2 has a smaller area error than the copy and Qwen Image 2.1 in 52 of the 64 cases (5.4 points on average over the 64 cases, against 10.0 for the copy), yet 33 of these 52 forecasts miss the target stage under Stage R@1.
Size cannot tell a green plant from a ripening one: in a top-view case twelve weeks ahead, GPT Image 2 misses the real area by only 3.6 points, but its plant is green where the real one is 94% yellow and brown.
Color, in turn, is informative only when color changes: over all 64 cases Qwen Image 2.1 beats AgroWM on yellow–brown error in 18, because most real futures are still green, but in only 4 of the 22 cases that reach grain filling or ripening, such as Fig. S2 a, where it is 17.4 points off and AgroWM 2.4.
In front views, every plant reaches the bottom edge (all 64 source and target images), so the vertical extent equals the culm slot of the Growth Script there.
blocks.zh:
仅用植物像素测量,可见区域、垂直范围以及黄褐色份额中的错误,可见像素得分错失的生长:在Fig。 S2 a Quen Image 2.1在面积和范围上为20.4和40.2点,而AgroWM为0.5和0.0。
然而,每个特点都只看到发展的一面。
对合适大小的预测可能处于错误阶段: 常规 图像2的面积误差小于64个案例中的52个案例(64个案例平均5.4分,而副本为10.0分),然而这52个预测中有33个错过了阶段R@1下的目标阶段.
大小不能从成熟的植物中看出绿色植物: 在12周前的顶级景点中, 常规 图像2只差3.6分就错过了真实面积,但其植物是绿色的,其中真实面积为94%的黄褐色.
色彩,反过来只有在颜色变化时才有信息:在全部64个案例中,Quen Image 2.1在18个黄色-褐色错误上击败AgroWM,因为大多数真实的未来仍然是绿色的,但在达到谷物填充或成熟的22个案例中只有4个,如Fig. S2 a,为17.4分,AgroWM 2.4.
在前面视图中,每个植物都到达了底端边缘(所有64个源头和目标图像),因此垂直范围等于那里生长脚本的culm槽.

blocks.en:
The 36 of 2,000 queries whose plant has fewer than five photos in the view are skipped.
Since the gallery contains today’s photo, the copy has an Event R@1 of zero, and its Stage R@1 is one only where the stage does not change, which is then the right answer.
Accordingly, Event R@1 never prefers the copy to AgroWM, and Stage R@1 does so in 3 of 63 cases, all with an unchanged stage.
blocks.zh:
在2 000个查询中,36个查询的工厂在视图中的照片不到5张。
由于画廊里有今天的照片, 复制品有一个事件R@1 零, R@1阶段只是舞台没有变化的一个阶段,这才是正确的答案。
因此,事件R@1从不喜欢复制到AgroWM,在63个案例中,阶段R@1有3个这样做,所有阶段都保持不变。

We classify each predicted and reference source-to-target change as decrease ( d < − 1 d<-1 pp), stable ( − 1 ≤ d ≤ 1 -1\leq d\leq 1 pp), or increase ( d > 1 d>1 pp), where d d is the change in the corresponding image proxy.

我们把每个预测的和参考的源到目标的变化分类为减少(d < − 1 d < 1 pp),稳定(1 → 1 d − 1\leq d\leq 1 pp),或增加(d > 1 d > 1pp),其中d是相应的图像代用物的变化.

blocks.en:
We align the predicted and Hindsight Tutor descriptions by view, section (Growth plan or Target phenotype), and slot, and remove the numeric evidence suffixes before comparison.
The 2,000 validation queries contain 18,000 reference descriptions across these two sections: five slots per front view and four per top view.
We encode the descriptions with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 [ 70 ] , use L2-normalized CLS embeddings, and report the mean cosine similarity over matched descriptions.
This score measures agreement with the Hindsight Tutor’s wording and meaning; the stage and numeric scores assess factual accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们通过视图,节(Growth plan or Goal Phenotype)和插槽来调整预测和Hindsight导师描述,并在比较前删除数字证据后缀.
2千个验证查询包含18000个参考说明,横跨这两节:前视区5个槽,上视区4个槽.
我们用 BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 [70] 编码描述,使用L2常态化的CLS嵌入,并在匹配描述上报告平均余弦相似度.
这一分数衡量标准与Hindsight教学者的措辞和含义一致;阶段和数字分数评估事实准确性。

blocks.en: Appendix D Datasets, Cleaning, and Training Pairs
blocks.zh: 附录D 数据集、清理和培训对等

blocks.en:
WGSR [ 15 ] , a public dataset of the Open Plant Image Archive [ 61 ] , holds 16,758 RGB photos of 93 rice accessions, taken from two sides and from the top about once a week from 42 to 182 days after sowing, on a LemnaTec phenotyping platform in a greenhouse in Beijing.
We keep the top view and one side view, called the front view, and generate white-background versions with Qwen Image 2.1 [ 68 ] , whose prompt, rewritten per photo by its prompt enhancer, asks to keep the plant unchanged and to replace everything else with white, so that methods and scores see only the plant.
Some outputs keep remnants of the pot or rails or shift the color of young leaves; the color-coverage gate and the pair gates below remove part of them.
Each photo carries one of the eight growth stages of Sec. 4.2 , and each accession its heading date.
To test on unseen plants, one random eligible plant per accession goes to validation before pairs are filtered and selected, and all photos of a plant stay in one split.
Stage-stratified sampling yields 10,000 training and 1,000 validation pairs, each in both views: 20,000 training queries from 252 plants of 85 accessions and 2,000 validation queries from 79 plants, one from each of 79 accessions, 78 of which also occur in training.
These queries use 7,540 photos of 331 plants from 86 accessions.
blocks.zh:
WGSR [15],开封植物影像档案馆公共数据集 [61],存有96,758张RGB93米入选的照片,拍摄时间为每周播种42天至182天左右的两面和顶部,在北京温室的LemnaTec phenotying平台上.
我们保留顶部视图和一侧视图,称为前视图,并用Quen Image 2.1 [68] 生成白底版,其即时,每张照片用其即时增强器重写,要求保持厂房不变,并用白色取代其他所有东西,这样的方法和分数只能看到厂房.
一些输出物保留了锅或铁轨的残迹,或者改变幼叶的颜色;彩色覆盖门和下面的配对门去除一部分.
每张照片都包含4.2第8个增长阶段中的一个,以及每个加入日期。
为了测试未见的植物,每个加入一个随机的合格植物在过滤和选择对子之前进行验证,一个植物的所有照片都停留在一个分裂中.
分阶段采集的抽样结果为10 000个培训和1 000个鉴定对,在两种观点中都是这样:来自252个工厂的20 000个培训查询,85个加入;来自79个工厂的2 000个认证查询,79个加入中各1个,其中78个也在培训中。
这些查询使用86个加入国的331个植物的7,540张照片.

It targets 40%, 35%, and 25% of the pairs at 1–4, 5–8, and 9–20 weeks; after the gates and the stratified sampling, 46%, 33%, and 21% of the validation queries fall in these ranges, so 54.4% are beyond four weeks.
The gates drop pairs whose change is not growth: photos at most three days apart; backward stages or panicles; early yellowing, that is, a yellow–brown share of at least 0.35 in tillering or jointing, or a rise of at least 0.20 from these stages within two stages; a front-height loss of at least 5 points toward a target before yellow ripening; and color coverage below 70%.

blocks.en:
WGSM [ 62 ] , also available through OPIA, contains images of 224 maize inbred lines acquired on a high-throughput phenotyping platform across nine growth stages, which cover vegetative growth, tasseling, silking, grain filling, and physiological maturity.
We retain one side view and construct strictly forward pairs within each plant; the 768 × \times 1,270 source images are padded by 10 pixels at the top to a 768 × \times 1,280 canvas, then processed to a white background with connected-component cleanup.
The resulting queries cover 432 plants, split by plant into 348 training and 84 held-out validation plants, with 6,400 and 1,600 queries ( Sec. 5.3 ).
The protocol maps stages S1–S9 to V3, V5, V7, V10, V14, VT, R1, R3, and R6, respectively, and uses the unrounded interval in days; the Planner receives the plant ID, source image, and interval, but not the recorded query stages or future image.
blocks.zh:
WGSM [62],也通过OPIA获得,包含在高通量的螺旋桨平台上获得的224条玉米进食线的图像,跨越9个生长阶段,覆盖植物生长,组装,丝绸,谷物填充,以及生理成熟.
我们保留一个侧视图,并在每个厂房内严格地构造前向对;768×\时 1,270个源图像由顶部的10个像素加成768×\时 1,280个帆布,然后加工成白色背景,进行连接组件清理.
由此产生的查询涉及432个工厂,按工厂分为348个培训厂和84个被搁置的验证厂,有6 400个和1 600个查询(第5.3节)。
协议地图分别为S1-S9至V3,V5,V7,V10,V14,VT,R1,R3和R6等阶段,并在数日内使用未圆形的间隔;计划员接收植物ID,源图像,和间隔,但不记录查询阶段或未来图像.

blocks.en: Each response contains one <GROWTH_COT> block with three sections in order: Stage reasoning , Growth plan , and Target phenotype . blocks.en:
For rice, the Planner receives the source image, accession, view, and rounded interval in weeks.
Growth plan fields may include an optional Guardrails: clause after the change description; unavailable metric evidence is omitted.
Rice numeric proxies use two decimal places, while Panicle uses visible / not visible and a signed visibility change.
The top-view template uses Canopy density and omits the front-view Culm/Height field.

blocks.en:
For maize, the query supplies the source image, plant ID, side view, and exact interval in days.
The four numeric fields use one decimal place; Tassel and Ear contain only qualitative visibility descriptions, and hidden organs are not reconstructed.
When the Culm change is within 2% of the source proxy, its numeric triplet may be replaced by the exact wording Stable within the registered two-percent proxy tolerance; Source/Target/Change suppressed. The maize Planner’s system prompt includes a general guide listing all nine stage IDs S1–S9, their corresponding growth stages, and visible descriptions; it does not identify the current or future stage of the query plant.
The dataset protocol maps S1–S9 to V3, V5, V7, V10, V14, VT, R1, R3, and R6 at nominal 25, 32, 50, 59, 70, 78, 85, 91, and 113 days after sowing; these protocol reference days do not imply that every plant was imaged on those dates.

四个数字字段使用一个小数位;塔塞尔和耳只包含定性可见度描述,隐藏的器官不重建.

数据集协议将S1-S9至V3,V5,V7,V10,V14,VT,R1,R3和R6标注在标称的25,32,50,59,70,78,85,91,以及播种后113天;这些协议参考日并不意味着每个植物都是在这些日期成像的.
